metadata.title: Arabic Grammar Memory Reference — Master Taxonomy
metadata.scope: A proposed bilingual reference of bounded grammatical lists, paradigms, patterns and compact rule packages; not a curriculum.

stages.Foundation: Initial reference material; not a course level.
stages.Core: Common follow-on material; order depends on the student's course.
stages.Further: Specialist, extended or more conditional material.

metadata.editorial_status: Taxonomy and topic coverage researched; full teaching content and answer keys are not yet authored or approved.
metadata.source_limitations: Sources establish topic coverage and conventions, not exhaustive validation of every planned rule. D07, D09, G16 and G17 require dedicated specialist sources.
